I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicates on door 6 again, on the morning shift. Thea was also the customer contact during the Sev 1 at their Superior terminal in #inc-qfl-sev1 last November. Marcus is in both channels, and I didn't find a newer contact named for this.

I didn't call gbrain again. It refused the last search because the connection isn't tied to any member, and it reported the error as not retryable. It stays unusable until someone with access to the brain's host fixes that. This answer comes only from channels Marcus can see; I didn't use Dana's DM.
